## Change

Describe the paper, correction, or website improvement and why it belongs. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Sources

For paper additions or metadata changes, link the publication or acceptance evidence and any other claims being updated. Otherwise write “Not applicable.”

## Validation

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Social-Atoms/awesome-social-sim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and checked for duplicate papers where applicable.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/build.py` and included any generated README or topic-page changes; `dist/` is not included.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build.py --check` and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` pass.

For interface changes, note the browser, mobile, and keyboard checks performed. Explain any checks that were not applicable or could not be run.
